title: Physical inventory correction movement candidate bundle

discoveryEvidence.movementIdentity: Canonical physical inventory movement identity is caller supplied; no correction-specific deterministic ID derivation exists.
discoveryEvidence.occurredOn: Canonical movement occurredOn is an explicit calendar date. FOOD-006Q observedAt is a UTC instant and no canonical observedAt-to-occurredOn mapping exists.
discoveryEvidence.attribution: Movement attribution is required bounded caller metadata and no correction-specific derivation exists.
discoveryEvidence.sourceReference: Movement sourceReference is required bounded caller metadata and no correction-specific derivation exists.
discoveryEvidence.cardinality: FOOD-006S exposes independent exact-batch allocations and no aggregate multi-batch physical movement contract exists.
discoveryEvidence.canonicalization: validateFoodPhysicalInventoryMovement is the canonical strict movement validator and returns frozen canonical evidence.
discoveryEvidence.persistence: appendFoodPhysicalInventoryMovement is a separate durable operation and is not called by FOOD-006T.
discoveryEvidence.evidenceSequence: Candidate creation alone does not enter FOOD-006 evidence sequencing. Migration 0005 remains unexecuted.

decision: FOOD-006T purely transforms one canonical FOOD-006S allocation result plus explicit per-exact-batch caller metadata into zero or more canonical physical inventory movement candidates.

metadataPerAllocation.batch: Exact allocation batch id/version used to bind metadata without relying on caller array order.
metadataPerAllocation.occurredOn: Explicit caller-supplied canonical calendar date. Never generated and never inferred by truncating FOOD-006Q observedAt.
metadataPerAllocation.sourceReference: Explicit caller-supplied canonical bounded provenance reference.

agreement: FOOD-006S no-correction-required requires an empty metadata array and returns zero movement candidates.
allocated: Metadata cardinality must exactly equal FOOD-006S allocation cardinality.
Each metadata entry binds exactly one FOOD-006S exact batch.
Unknown or duplicate metadata batch bindings are rejected.
Duplicate movement IDs across candidate movements are rejected.
Exactly one movement candidate is produced for each FOOD-006S allocation.
Candidate batch equals allocation batch exactly.
Candidate SKU equals FOOD-006S SKU exactly.
Candidate packageCount equals allocation packageCount exactly.
Candidate movementType equals FOOD-006S proposedMovementType exactly.
Canonical movement validation owns movement identity/date/metadata validation.
Output follows canonical FOOD-006S allocation order even when metadata input order differs.
provenance: The canonical FOOD-006S allocation plan is retained in the candidate bundle. Candidate metadata is detached into canonical FoodPhysicalInventoryMovement values.
doesNotEstablish: physical truth of the underlying count
physical truth of the caller-selected batch allocation
